editorial:
Ever wondered what would happen if your cool babysitter turned out to be a complete nightmare? You follow Cole, a shy kid who finally finds a friend in Bee, the hottest and nicest babysitter in the neighborhood. Everything seems great until Cole accidentally stays up late and catches her doing something terrifying. He quickly finds out that Bee and her friends are actually part of a scary cult, and they need to sacrifice him to get their youth back. It is a wild ride that mixes blood and laughs, feeling like a twisted version of a teen movie that keeps you on your toes.

The acting is great, especially since it does not take itself too seriously. The action moves fast, and the twists are surprising without being too confusing. While some of the gore might be too much for some, it mostly feels like a fun carnival ride. If you love movies that make you laugh while you scream, you will love this. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best look, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for those bright colors.
endingExplained: After a long fight, Cole manages to outsmart Bee and her cult friends. He uses their own rules against them and eventually kills Bee, stopping the ritual for good. The movie ends with Cole becoming much more confident and brave because of everything he went through. He is no longer the scared kid from the start, and he even finds a new crush, showing that he finally grew up.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror movies that are also funny and fast.
